title: 5 Sendbox Stores To Shop From This Month
body_markdown:
Last month, we launched our[business platform](https://sendbox.co/business?ref=nav) that allows you (as a business owner) to reach new customers, generate more sales and grow into a worldwide favourite. Currently, there are a handful of business owners who are utilizing this platform during these times and we will be sharing some stores that grabbed our attention last month.


#### [Ankarahux Store](https://my.sendbox.co/ankarahux)


For people who are lovers of ankara prints, this is the store for you. On this store, you can get all kinds of African ankara prints 100% cotton for wholesale supplies, asoebi and also ready to wears


#### [Fabskollexion Store](https://my.sendbox.co/fabskollexion)


This is the office bag plug store located in Lagos, Nigeria. If you are looking to buy pocket-friendly handbags, look no further because this store has you covered. The main goal of Fabskollexion is to inspire working-class women with their lovely bags.


#### [Sbt_hub Store](https://my.sendbox.co/sbt_hub)


They say the perfume of incense reminds us of the pervading influence of virtue and purifies our space. This store sells astonishing incense (turaren wuta) that will help to refresh your space. They also sell DIY Sudanese spa products to help you look good.


#### [Teabyfade](https://my.sendbox.co/teabyfade)


This fashion online accessories store provides quality and affordable fashion accessories like jewellery, bags, shoes, hats and many more. And like we stated above, looking good is serious business.


#### [NOFA Collections](https://my.sendbox.co/nofacollections)


You too can be a part of this community as a business owner by creating your special online store on our business platform. Click[here](https://sendbox.co/business) to begin.
